_comment: Every gated staff page and the capability its gate falls back to -
NAV_NEEDS in nala-shared.js, as the suites assert it. The
phone_cases.json pattern: NAV and NAV_UNLISTED are what the app
reads, this is what the tests expect, and whichever side a new page
misses fails by name. The suite also scans the pages themselves for
canOpen gates, so a page built with a gate and listed nowhere is
named here too - which is the audit of 12 Sep made permanent.
A page whose need is manageStaff is admin-only: it gets no row in the
